## s01-v19 — argument map

*sarvato vilasadbhaktitejodhvastāvṛter mama.* My covering shattered by all-radiant devotion-light; may even my thoughts, which face all real things, perish. Covering destroyed from all sides at once — then even thought, facing reality directly, ends.

### Open
- v.19 *cintānām api naśyatu* — whose thoughts perish, and is thought's end extinction or facing (*pratyakṣa*)? Left open.
